items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jo comes in the wings where I am and he takes his sticks and he puts them in my hand. He says, you got it... And I went on and did the show... I stayed on the band maybe a couple of months

ctx.x: I’ll take a look at it because I don’t want to have interrupted you.
No, that’s cool. I was saying when I met Jo in the Dunbar Hotel.
